details.name: Pogranichnik
details.quote: Pogranichnik, Rhodes Island operator, and officer serving the Order of Steel Oath, reporting for duty. The situation is urgent. I respectfully request a brief on your battle plan, at your earliest convenience.
details.infection: Oripathy negative, based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Battlefield Tactics: Military Theory He believes that every theory should be traceable to actual wars, and applicable to real battles.
details.exp2d: Team Management: Mentor To the young recruits, he always attempts to share his experience and knowledge, and impress upon them the ideals and aspirations that he has held dear for all this time.
details.hb1d: Culture: Living History Book His preferred approach to learning about this world is to study its history and everything that happened to this land.
details.hb2d: Mind Honing: Chess Master "It's less of a match and more like a hard-fought battle." — Every operator who played chess with Pogranichnik felt they could relate to this feeling.
